andre drummond.comment: Drummond (head) did not return to Wednesday's 121-102 win over the Cavaliers.

caleb martin.comment: Martin didn't return for the second half of Friday's win over the Suns due to a left ankle sprain, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

gui santos.comment: Santos exited Friday's game against the Trail Blazers with a knee injury in the second half and won't return.

jakobe walter.comment: Walter won't return to Friday's game against Brooklyn due to a right quad contusion, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.

jaxson hayes.comment: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Mavericks, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

jaylen brown.comment: Brown (hamstring) won't return to Wednesday's game against Miami, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports. He finished with six points (2-8 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 2-2 FT), one rebound and one assist over 17 minutes.

lamelo ball.comment: Ball (ankle) did not return to Wednesday's 113-106 win over the Thunder.

larry nance.comment: Nance exited Monday's game against the Thunder due to a sore right ankle and he will not return, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

moritz wagner.comment: Wagner (knee) will not return to Wednesday's game against the Bucks, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.

nolan traore.comment: Traore (hamstring) won't return to Friday's game against Orlando, Meghan Triplett of YES Network reports. He finished with four points (2-6 FG, 0-2 3Pt) and two assists over 18 minutes.

ryan dunn.comment: Dunn won't return to Friday's game against the Jazz due to a right quad injury, Amanda Pflugrad of 3TV Phoenix reports.

tj mcconnell.comment: Rick Carlisle revealed during his postgame interview that McConnell exited Friday's 128-119 loss with a left hamstring issue, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

yanic konan niederhauser.comment: Niederhauser suffered a right toe injury during Friday's game against the Pelicans and won't return, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.

zach edey.comment: Edey (ankle) did not return to Wednesday's 115-97 win over the Clippers. He finished with seven points (3-4 FG, 1-1 FT), four rebounds, two assists and two blocks across nine minutes.
